boundary: Questions guide repository review; they do not select definitions or promote existing research outcomes.

assumptions: Declared source/enrichment inputs require provenance; no physical interpretation by analogy.
counterexamples: Bare vector-space naturality is too strong to select nontrivial sector structure.
Bool Tick has only its classified tag information at fixed source.
Anchored relational chirality does not select flavor constants.
terms.definition: A candidate common typed relational/compositional source, with retained records and admitted equivalences, supporting a shared source-indexed interface calculus. Sector records are indexed inputs whose provenance must be explicit; they are not unrestricted fitted adapters.
residuals: No common carrier for all sectors has been constructed.
The primitive relation/composition types and allowed source records remain to be selected.
A shared grammar does not yet prove a shared physical witness.
review_questions: What are the objects and relations?
Which composition and retained data are primitive?
Which inequivalent carrier candidates exist?

assumptions: Declared source/enrichment inputs require provenance; no physical interpretation by analogy.
counterexamples: A face-indexed summary does not retain all ordered-path spatial information.
terms.definition: A candidate family of typed geometric realizations attached to the relational source through explicit maps: topology, metric, differential, causal or spatial structures must each declare whether primitive, derived or added. An external analytic interval is not automatically physical spacetime.
residuals: No common path-to-spacetime construction is identified.
Metric, dimension, Lorentzian/causal structure and their source authority remain open.
review_questions: Is geometry intrinsic, derived, or ambient?
What topology, metric, causal or differential structure is justified?
Which structures are added assumptions?

assumptions: Declared source/enrichment inputs require provenance; no physical interpretation by analogy.
counterexamples: Equal corners allow different Hamiltonians and intermediate images.
A reflected return and positive continuation need not agree.
terms.definition: Candidate admissible source operations, their compositions and retained schedules, together with explicitly declared realization laws. Analytic flow parameters, rates and return orientation are separate from any physical-clock claim.
residuals: Physical time and energy calibration remain open.
Source-only unique generator selection is not established.
Cross-sector dynamics and one common witness need transport proofs.
review_questions: What is an admissible evolution or composition?
Is physical time derived or supplied?
What selects dynamics beyond endpoint compatibility?

assumptions: Declared source/enrichment inputs require provenance; no physical interpretation by analogy.
counterexamples: A scalar readout can annihilate independently controlled directions.
Finite injectivity can lose its lower bound at completion.
Flavor normalization can leave calibration/gain fibers.
terms.definition: Candidate source-authorized measurement/probe maps on typed interfaces, respecting declared equivalences and transport. Terminal readouts may be quotients; joint faithfulness and cutoff-uniform stability are separate claims, not requirements imposed on every individual scalar.
residuals: The authorized probe family and physical measurement model are not selected.
Readout descent, empirical calibration and common-observer compatibility remain open.
review_questions: What maps turn retained structure into measurements?
What information is lost?
Which maps descend through declared equivalences?
Which theories, phenomena and regimes are included in the first bounded target set?
What counts as recovery for each target?
Which sector interfaces overlap?
What equations and witness-preserving transports express agreement?
Which data are fitting inputs and which are held out?
What calibration and uncertainty are allowed?
What quantitative criterion constitutes passing or failing?
Which observations or exact obstructions would exclude a specified branch?
Which alternatives remain?
What would refute the broader existential claim rather than one construction?
What must be derived rather than inserted?
Which free choices and adapters are allowed?
What constraints exceed mere representability or fitting?
